scope: Scoville-family Skill and Scribe-reference routing; host and product Skills remain independently discoverable.
invariants: Chat delivery alone neither activates nor suppresses Scribe.
A domain owner's normal result does not activate Scribe merely because it contains prose.
Scribe activates when wording itself is a requested artifact or transformation target.
Mixed tasks activate only the owners required by each independently classified segment.
Explicit Scribe invocation applies to the current task and explicit opt-out prevents automatic Scribe activation.
A referential follow-up transformation reactivates Scribe; a pivot to ordinary explanation does not inherit it.
Fixed supplied insertion without wording judgment does not activate Scribe unless explicitly invoked.

cases.request: Explain why the retry loop behaves this way and what would prove the diagnosis.
hard_checks: Answer quality remains owned by the compact system prompt.
No Scribe Core or reference read occurs.

cases.request: Tell me briefly what is done, what failed, and what happens next.
hard_checks: Preserve observed status and limits without loading Scribe.

cases.request: Summarize this supplied retry change as change, effect, and remaining risk for reuse in a report.
hard_checks: Preserve conditions, exact derived values, and uncertainty.

cases.request: In one sentence, remind me what your previous answer concluded.
hard_checks: Retain the prior conclusion without treating the recap as a source transformation artifact.

cases.request: Review this patch for correctness and report actionable findings.
hard_checks: Code owns implementation evidence and findings wording is not an independent artifact.

cases.request: Audit this supplied release note for unclear wording and factual drift without rewriting it.
hard_checks: Report location, reader effect, and correction direction without rewriting.

cases.request: Research the current implementation options and explain the evidence-backed recommendation.
hard_checks: Research owns the decision-ready answer; prose alone does not add Scribe.

cases.request: Research the current options and turn the findings into a publication-ready report for engineering leadership.
hard_checks: Research owns evidence; Scribe owns the separately constrained report artifact.

cases.request: Write a README section from these supplied product facts for later publication.
hard_checks: Use only supplied claims and produce reusable documentation prose.

cases.request: Implement the fix and add only any comment needed to express a non-obvious code constraint.
hard_checks: Code owns incidental comments subordinate to implementation.

cases.request: Inspect this function and write a reusable explanatory docstring that preserves its verified contract.
hard_checks: Code derives behavior; Scribe owns the independently requested docstring wording.

cases.request: Implement, validate, and commit this bounded fix with a conventional message.
hard_checks: Code owns the subordinate commit message and authorization remains separate.

cases.request: Inspect the verified diff and formulate a precise commit title and body for me to reuse.
hard_checks: Code owns diff truth; Scribe owns explicitly requested reusable commit wording.

cases.request: Extract the text between these markers byte-exactly and return nothing else.
hard_checks: Preserve the selected boundary and bytes exactly.

cases.request: Insert this fully supplied unchanged string into the named field without wording judgment.
hard_checks: Insert the supplied string exactly without loading Scribe.

cases.request: Create a durable implementation Plan with Work Items and Decisions.
hard_checks: Plan owns structure, lifecycle, and record wording required by its format.

cases.request: Create the Plan and separately polish the decision rationale for publication without changing its claims.
hard_checks: Plan owns lifecycle; Scribe owns the independently requested claim-preserving rationale edit.

cases.request: Create a compact continuation handoff for a new session.
hard_checks: Handoff owns its compact fixed transfer artifact.

cases.request: Write a customer-facing announcement here in chat so I can copy and publish it.
hard_checks: Chat delivery does not suppress Scribe when reuse and publication intent are explicit.

cases.request: Use Scoville Scribe to explain this mechanism as polished reusable prose.
hard_checks: Explicit invocation activates Scribe for the current task.

cases.request: Write a disposable draft, but do not use Scoville Scribe.
hard_checks: Use compact fallback behavior and load no Scribe file.

cases.request: Use Scoville Scribe to rewrite this publication text, but the named Skill is unavailable.
hard_checks: Use compact fallback behavior and briefly report that the explicitly requested Skill is unavailable.

cases.request: Make that announcement shorter while preserving every claim.
hard_checks: The referential follow-up reactivates Scribe even without repeating its name.

cases.request: Why did shortening that announcement require preserving the qualifier?
hard_checks: Do not inherit Scribe from the prior artifact task.

cases.request: Implement this responsive UI using the supplied fixed labels without changing their wording.
hard_checks: Code and UI own implementation and rendered proof; fixed labels do not activate Scribe.

cases.request: Implement this responsive UI and formulate its labels, help text, and recovery error.
hard_checks: Scribe applies only to the variable interface-text segments.

cases.request: Write the label, help text, and verified recovery error for this existing UI behavior.
hard_checks: Scribe owns the copy; add Code or UI only when behavior derivation or rendered proof is independently requested.

cases.request: Generate several materially different solution mechanisms before we choose one.
hard_checks: Brainstorm owns divergence; ordinary prose presentation does not add Scribe.
